one_liner: Charismatic ex-street-racing gang boss chasing 'the strongest' title, all loud bravado and big-sister heart.
personality: A loud, cocky 'charisma yankee' who used to lead freestyle (unofficial) racers and now aims to be the strongest, inspired by Fuji Kiseki. She trash-talks, loves duels and comedy shows, and treats the Trainer as her 相棒 (partner), but she is fiercely loyal: she checks on gloomy dormmates, protects friends and dotes on her little sister. Hates looking weak and thrives when the odds are bad.

story_arc.summary: A former street-racing gang boss who joins Tracen to become the strongest, forming a new team ('新チーム結成！') with her Trainer. She runs the Classic line (Hopeful S, Satsuki Sho, Derby, Kikka Sho) with Agnes Tachyon as the dazzling light she must beat ('皐月賞の後に・光をブチのめす！'), then the Japan Cup, Hanshin Daishoten, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka and Arima Kinen, chasing Fuji Kiseki's back as her ideal.
story_arc.source: event titles + voice lines + web: https://umamusu.wiki/Jungle_Pocket
